title: Talking
descriptionFa: فرق say، tell، ask، speak، talk، answer و reply.

words.example: How do you say 'book' in Spanish?
words.tipFa: say بلافاصله با آدم نمیاد: He said his name، نه He said me. say hello / goodbye / thank you.

words.example: She said that she was tired.
Can you tell me where the bus station is?
words.tipFa: tell بلافاصله با آدم میاد: tell me, tell her. نه say me.

words.example: He told me his name, but I forgot it.
My uncle loves to tell a joke at dinner.
words.tipFa: tell a story هم همین‌طور: قصه گفتن.

words.example: Can I ask you a question?
words.tipFa: ask someone to do something: I asked him to turn off the radio.

words.example: If you need anything, just ask for it.
words.tipFa: ask for help, ask for the menu.
برای زبان speak می‌گیم، نه talk: Do you speak French?

words.example: I like to talk to my grandmother about the old days.
Can you answer the phone, please? I'm cooking.
words.tipFa: w خونده نمی‌شه: «آنسِر». answer the door = در رو باز کردن.

words.example: He didn't reply to my email.
